'''Alejandro Rojas Wainer''' (31 January 1945 – 16 April 2018) was a Chilean-Canadian academic. He was elected to the [[Chamber of Deputies of Chile]] for [[Popular Unity (Chile)|Popular Unity]] in 1973, but left office after the [[1973 Chilean coup d'état|coup d'état]]. Subsequently, he moved to Canada, and taught at the [[University of British Columbia]].

==Biography==
Rojas Wainer was born in Santiago on 31 January 1945. He attended the Manuel de Salas Experimental School affiliated with the [[University of Chile]]. Upon graduation, he was accepted into the University of Chile Dental School. Rojas Wainer became the first person elected to three terms as leader the [[University of Chile Student Federation]], serving between from 1970 to 1973.

While in college, he was active with the [[Communist Youth of Chile]]. Rojas Wainer was elected to the Chamber of Deputies for the [[Popular Unity (Chile)|Popular Unity]] political coalition in 1973, while still president of the student federation.<ref>{{cite news|title=U. de Chile lamenta el fallecimiento de Alejandro Rojas, ex presidente de la FECh y diputado de la República|url=https://www.uchile.cl/noticias/142609/fallecio-alejandro-rojas-ex-presidente-de-la-fech|accessdate=18 April 2018|publisher=University of Chile|date=17 April 2018|language=es}}</ref> After the coup d'état forced [[Salvador Allende]] out of power, Rojas Wainer left Chile to pursue graduate studies at the [[University of Geneva]] and [[York University]].

He remained in Canada, teaching at the University of British Columbia.<ref>{{cite news|title=Alejandro Rojas, PhD|url=https://www.landfood.ubc.ca/person/alejandro-rojas/|accessdate=18 April 2018|publisher=University of British Columbia}}</ref> Rojas Wainer died of cancer at the age of 73 on 16 April 2018 in Vancouver.<ref>{{cite news|title=A los 73 años murió el ex diputado comunista Alejandro Rojas Wainer|url=https://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/pais/politica/partido-comunista/a-los-73-anos-murio-el-ex-diputado-comunista-alejandro-rojas-wainer/2018-04-16/190659.html|accessdate=18 April 2018|work=Cooperativa|date=16 April 2018|language=es}}</ref>
